workflows.name: Prefill remembered email

check_box.name: Check remember me
check_box.__wwdescription: Re-check 'Remember me' if an email was remembered

fill_email.name: Prefill email field
fill_email.__wwdescription: Put the remembered email back into the email field

check_remembered.name: Read remembered email
check_remembered.__wwdescription: Read a previously remembered email from localStorage, if any

workflows.description: On page load, if the user previously checked 'Remember me', prefill their email and check the box again

interactions.name: Handle Login

call_login.name: Call Supabase login RPC
call_login.__wwdescription: POST credentials to the Supabase public.login() RPC endpoint

block_admin.name: Block admin login here
block_admin.__wwdescription: Reject admin accounts here with a clear message, and clear the fields, without saving any session

check_admin.name: Is destination admin?
check_admin.__wwdescription: Branch: go to the admin page, or keep checking

goto_wizard.name: Go to Tutor Wizard
goto_wizard.__wwdescription: Navigate to the tutor complete profile page

check_wizard.name: Is destination wizard?
check_wizard.__wwdescription: Branch: go to the tutor wizard, or fall through to the calendar

save_session.name: Save session
save_session.__wwdescription: Persist the returned token/user, honoring the 'Remember me' checkbox — only reached for non-admin accounts

set_error_msg.name: Set error message
set_error_msg.__wwdescription: Show a friendly error message when the login RPC call fails, and clear the email/password fields

check_not_admin.name: Is this an admin account?
check_not_admin.__wwdescription: Block admin accounts from logging in through the public login page — admins must use the dedicated admin portal

set_loading_true.name: Set loading
set_loading_true.__wwdescription: Disable the login button while the request is in flight

compute_destination.name: Compute destination
compute_destination.__wwdescription: Figure out where to send the user: admin page, the tutor profile wizard, or the calendar

loading_false_error.name: Stop loading
loading_false_error.__wwdescription: Hide the loading state (disables spinner) after a failed login

loading_false_success.name: Stop loading
loading_false_success.__wwdescription: Hide the loading state (disables spinner) after a successful login

set_button_logging_in.name: Show 'Logging in...'
set_button_logging_in.__wwdescription: Switch the button label to 'Logging in...'

reset_button_text_error.name: Reset button label
reset_button_text_error.__wwdescription: Put the button label back to 'Log In' after a failed attempt

open_popup_admin_blocked.name: Open error popup (admin blocked)
open_popup_admin_blocked.__wwdescription: Open the same error popup so the admin-blocked message is actually visible

loading_false_error_admin.name: Stop loading (admin blocked)
loading_false_error_admin.__wwdescription: Hide the loading state after blocking an admin account here

reset_button_text_success.name: Reset button label
reset_button_text_success.__wwdescription: Put the button label back to 'Log In' before navigating away

reset_button_text_error_admin.name: Reset button label (admin blocked)
reset_button_text_error_admin.__wwdescription: Reset button label after blocking an admin account here

interactions.description: Authenticate against the Supabase public.login() RPC — blocks admin accounts from logging in here (must use the admin portal, popup shown), honors 'Remember me', toggles button state, stores the session, computes destination, navigates, and clears fields on any failed/blocked attempt

_ww-text_text.en: Sign in to continue your learning journey
